item.title: A Review on the Properties and Nature of Light
item.description: arXiv:2610.13932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The following paper is a detailed review on the properties and nature in relation to the phenomena known as 'light'. The paper tries to chronologically detail the development of theories and related experiments from the philosophical Greco-Roman and Indian schools of thought to the modern quantum theories.
item.dc:creator: Prachurjo Dutta Roy
